scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana
description:
The Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana is a welfare scheme launched by the Government of Madhya Pradesh in India. 

This scheme was initiated on 15th November 2019. 

The primary objective of this scheme is to promote inter-caste marriages in the state. 

The government aims to reduce caste-based discrimination and encourage social harmony through this initiative. 

The scheme provides financial assistance to couples who belong to different castes. 

Under this scheme, a financial incentive of ₹50,000 is provided to couples who marry outside their caste. 

This amount is intended to help the newly married couples in their initial phase of life. 

The scheme is particularly focused on encouraging inter-caste marriages among Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes. 

The government has set a target to promote at least 1,000 inter-caste marriages annually through this initiative. 

The eligibility criteria for the Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana are clearly defined. 

Both partners in the marriage must be residents of Madhya Pradesh. 

The age limit for the male applicant is 21 years and for the female applicant is 18 years. 

Both partners must belong to different castes. 

The couple must provide proof of their inter-caste marriage. 

They must also submit a marriage certificate issued by the competent authority. 

The application process is straightforward and can be completed online. 

Applicants must visit the official website of the Madhya Pradesh government. 

They need to fill out the application form available on the website. 

The form requires personal details such as name, age, address, and caste of both partners. 

Applicants must upload necessary documents including identity proof and marriage certificate. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The financial assistance is disbursed directly into the bank account of the beneficiaries. 

The government has established a timeline for the disbursement of funds. 

Once the application is approved, the amount is usually transferred within 30 days. 

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Disabled Welfare of Madhya Pradesh. 

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the department at their official helpline number. 

The department also provides support through local offices across the state. 

The Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana is part of a broader initiative to promote social equality. 

The government aims to create a society where caste does not determine social status or opportunities. 

Since its launch, the scheme has received positive feedback from various sections of society. 

Many couples have benefited from the financial assistance provided under this scheme. 

The government has also organized awareness campaigns to promote the scheme. 

These campaigns aim to educate people about the benefits of inter-caste marriages. 

The scheme is seen as a step towards eliminating caste-based prejudices. 

It encourages young people to look beyond caste affiliations when choosing their partners. 

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is significant for many couples. 

It helps them in setting up their new lives together. 

The Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana is a unique initiative in Madhya Pradesh. 

It reflects the government's commitment to social justice and equality. 

The scheme aligns with the national vision of promoting social integration. 

It is an important tool in the fight against caste discrimination in the state. 

The government has allocated a specific budget for this scheme each financial year. 

In the 2020-2021 financial year, the government allocated ₹5 crore for this initiative. 

This budget is expected to increase as the scheme gains popularity. 

The Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana is a model for other states. 

It demonstrates how financial incentives can encourage social change. 

The scheme has the potential to create a ripple effect in society. 

As more couples opt for inter-caste marriages, social barriers may begin to dissolve. 

The government continues to monitor the progress of the scheme. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate its impact on society. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is also collected to improve the scheme further. 

The Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana is a significant step towards a more inclusive society. 

It embodies the principles of equality and justice enshrined in the Indian Constitution. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's proactive approach to social issues. 

It encourages dialogue and understanding among different communities. 

The Mukhyamantri Samajik Samrasta Antarjatiya Vivah Shagun Yojana is an essential part of Madhya Pradesh's welfare initiatives. 

It aims to foster a culture of acceptance and respect for diversity. 

The scheme is expected to evolve over time based on the needs of society. 

The government remains committed to supporting inter-caste marriages through this initiative.
